positive_snippets: My stay at Destiny House was very pleasant. The location is excellent and the community was very nice to live in. The staff was quite helpful, although I would give them three out of five stars. The best part was our host, Shilpa ji, who was a very good host and helped me even when I called her late at night. Overall, it was a very good experience.
It's a best and economical place to stay. The housekeeper is a good guy. It's a safe place with no noise and It's clean too. Look at the photos I have taken.

I had a wonderful stay here. The room was spacious, spotless, and very comfortable. The staff was incredibly warm and attentive, ensuring a hassle-free experience. Service was prompt, and the food was delicious. Highly recommended for a relaxing and pleasant stay!
